title: Masala Dosa
instructions: Soak rice and urad dal for 4 hours, grind to a smooth batter and ferment overnight.
Boil and mash the potatoes, then temper mustard seeds, onion and turmeric and mix in the potato.
Spread the batter thin on a hot griddle and drizzle oil until golden and crisp.
Place the potato filling inside, fold the dosa and serve hot with chutney and sambar.

title: Idli
instructions: Soak rice and urad dal separately for 5 hours, then grind into a thick batter.
Mix, add salt and ferment overnight until the batter doubles in volume.
Pour into greased idli moulds and steam for 10-12 minutes until fluffy.
Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.

title: Poha
instructions: Rinse the poha gently and let it drain until soft.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, green chili and onion in oil until golden.
Add diced potato and turmeric, cover and cook until tender.
Fold in the poha, season with salt and lemon, and garnish with coriander.

title: Upma
instructions: Dry roast the suji until lightly fragrant and set aside.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chili, ginger and onion in oil.
Add 2.5 cups of hot water with salt and bring to a boil.
Slowly stir in the roasted suji, cover and cook until thick and fluffy.

title: Aloo Paratha
instructions: Knead the atta with water and a little oil into a soft dough and rest for 15 minutes.
Mash boiled potatoes with onion, green chili, coriander and spices.
Stuff a dough ball with the filling, seal and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee on both sides until golden brown.

title: Besan Chilla
instructions: Whisk besan with water into a smooth, pourable batter.
Stir in chopped onion, tomato, green chili, turmeric, coriander and salt.
Pour a ladle onto a hot oiled pan and spread into a thin pancake.
Cook both sides until golden and serve hot with chutney.

title: Vegetable Uttapam
instructions: Use fermented dosa batter and pour a thick round onto a hot griddle.
Sprinkle chopped onion, tomato, capsicum and green chili on top.
Drizzle oil around the edges and press the toppings gently.
Flip and cook until both sides are golden, then serve with chutney.

title: Medu Vada
instructions: Soak urad dal for 4 hours and grind into a thick fluffy batter.
Mix in chopped green chili, ginger, curry leaves and crushed pepper.
Shape into rings with wet hands and slide into hot oil.
Deep fry until golden and crisp, then serve with sambar and chutney.

title: Rava Idli
instructions: Roast suji and mix with curd and grated carrot into a thick batter.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and green chili and stir in.
Add a pinch of fruit salt, mix and pour into greased moulds.
Steam for 12 minutes and serve hot with coconut chutney.

title: Methi Thepla
instructions: Mix atta, chopped methi, besan and spices into a firm dough using curd and water.
Rest for 15 minutes, then divide and roll into thin discs.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little oil on both sides.
Press until light brown spots appear and serve with curd or pickle.

title: Sabudana Khichdi
instructions: Soak sabudana overnight until soft and drained.
Roast and coarsely crush the peanuts.
Temper cumin, green chili and diced potato until the potato is cooked.
Add sabudana and crushed peanuts, toss gently and finish with lemon.

title: Moong Dal Cheela
instructions: Soak moong dal for 3 hours and grind with green chili and ginger into a batter.
Stir in chopped onion, coriander and salt.
Spread a thin layer on a hot oiled pan.
Cook both sides until golden and serve with green chutney.

title: Paneer Paratha
instructions: Knead atta into a soft dough and rest for 15 minutes.
Crumble paneer and mix with green chili, coriander and spices.
Stuff a dough ball, seal and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.

title: Semiya Upma
instructions: Dry roast vermicelli until light golden and set aside.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and onion, then add carrot and peas.
Pour in 3 cups of hot water with salt and bring to a boil.
Stir in the vermicelli, cover and cook until the water is absorbed.

title: Pesarattu
instructions: Soak whole green moong for 5 hours and grind with ginger and chili.
Add cumin and salt to the batter.
Spread thin on a hot griddle and top with chopped onion.
Drizzle oil, cook until crisp and serve with ginger chutney.

title: Egg Bhurji
instructions: Saute onion, green chili and tomato until soft.
Add turmeric, red chili powder and salt.
Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble on medium heat.
Cook until just set and garnish with coriander.

title: Masala Omelette
instructions: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Mix in finely chopped onion, tomato, green chili and coriander.
Pour onto a hot oiled pan and spread evenly.
Cook both sides until set and serve with toast.

title: Bread Upma
instructions: Cut the bread into small cubes.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and onion, then add tomato and turmeric.
Toss in the bread cubes and mix until coated.
Sprinkle lemon and coriander and serve immediately.

title: Rava Dosa
instructions: Mix suji, rice flour and atta into a thin watery batter and rest 20 minutes.
Add cumin, chopped green chili and curry leaves.
Pour the batter onto a hot griddle from a height to create a lacy pattern.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp and golden, then serve with chutney.

title: Sooji Halwa
instructions: Roast suji in ghee on low heat until golden and aromatic.
In a separate pot, boil water with sugar and cardamom into a syrup.
Slowly pour the hot syrup into the suji while stirring to avoid lumps.
Cook until thick, fold in roasted cashews and serve warm.

title: Rajma Chawal
instructions: Soak rajma overnight and pressure cook until soft.
Saute onion, ginger and garlic, then add pureed tomato and spices.
Add the cooked rajma with its water and simmer until thick.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

title: Chana Masala
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook until tender.
Make a masala of onion, ginger, garlic and tomato with spices.
Add the chickpeas and a little cooking water, then simmer.
Finish with garam masala and serve with bhature or rice.

title: Dal Tadka
instructions: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and salt until soft.
Prepare a tadka of ghee, cumin, garlic, onion and tomato.
Pour the tadka into the cooked dal and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or roti.

title: Dal Makhani
instructions: Soak black dal and rajma overnight, then pressure cook until very soft.
Simmer with tomato puree, ginger and spices on low heat.
Stir in butter and cream and cook slowly until rich and creamy.
Garnish with a swirl of cream and serve with naan.

title: Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch the spinach and blend into a smooth puree.
Saute onion, garlic and tomato with spices.
Add the spinach puree and simmer for a few minutes.
Fold in paneer cubes and cream and serve hot.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Blend tomato, onion and cashews into a smooth puree.
Cook the puree in butter with spices until the rawness disappears.
Stir in cream and a pinch of sugar for balance.
Add paneer cubes, simmer briefly and serve with naan.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Temper cumin seeds and saute onion until golden.
Add tomato, turmeric and spices and cook into a masala.
Add potato and cauliflower florets and mix to coat.
Cover and cook on low heat until tender, then garnish with coriander.

title: Bhindi Masala
instructions: Wash, dry and chop the bhindi, then saute until the stickiness is gone.
In the same pan, cook onion until golden.
Add tomato, turmeric and coriander powder and cook into a masala.
Return the bhindi, toss to coat and cook until tender.

title: Jeera Rice
instructions: Rinse and soak the rice for 15 minutes.
Temper cumin seeds and bay leaf in oil until fragrant.
Add the drained rice and saute gently for a minute.
Add 3 cups water and salt, cover and cook until fluffy.

title: Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Saute whole spices and onion until golden.
Add chopped carrot, beans and peas and saute briefly.
Add the soaked rice, garam masala, salt and 3 cups water.
Cover and cook until the rice is fluffy and the vegetables are tender.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Saute onion until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato and spices and cook into a thick masala.
Add the chicken pieces and saute until coated and sealed.
Add water, cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked and tender.

title: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in curd and spices, then grill or pan-sear.
Cook a smooth tomato puree in butter with spices.
Stir in cream and a touch of sugar.
Add the cooked chicken, simmer and finish with garam masala.

title: Kadhi Pakora
instructions: Make a batter of besan and onion and deep fry into pakoras.
Whisk curd with besan, turmeric and water into a thin mixture.
Simmer the curd mixture with a cumin tadka until it thickens.
Drop in the pakoras and simmer briefly before serving with rice.

title: Baingan Bharta
instructions: Roast the brinjal over a flame until charred, then peel and mash.
Saute onion, garlic and green chili until soft.
Add tomato and spices and cook into a masala.
Mix in the mashed brinjal, cook through and garnish with coriander.

title: Matar Paneer
instructions: Make a smooth onion-tomato-ginger masala with spices.
Add the peas and a little water and cook until tender.
Add paneer cubes and simmer for a few minutes.
Finish with garam masala and serve with roti.

title: Chana Dal
instructions: Pressure cook chana dal with turmeric and salt until soft.
Prepare a tadka of cumin, garlic, onion and tomato.
Mix the tadka into the dal and simmer.
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or roti.

title: Lemon Rice
instructions: Cook the rice and spread it out to cool.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, curry leaves and turmeric.
Switch off the heat and add lemon juice and salt.
Gently fold in the rice until evenly coated.

title: Sambar
instructions: Pressure cook toor dal until soft and mash well.
Boil mixed vegetables with tamarind extract and sambar powder.
Add the cooked dal and simmer until everything melds.
Finish with a mustard and curry leaf tadka.

title: Vegetable Biryani
instructions: Parboil the basmati rice with whole spices and drain.
Cook the vegetables in a curd and biryani masala gravy.
Layer the rice over the vegetables and sprinkle fried onions and mint.
Cover and cook on dum (low heat) for 20 minutes, then gently mix.

title: Egg Curry
instructions: Boil and peel the eggs, then lightly fry with turmeric.
Make an onion-tomato-ginger-garlic masala with spices.
Add water to form a gravy and simmer.
Add the eggs, finish with garam masala and serve with rice.

title: Paneer Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate paneer and capsicum in curd and spices, then grill until charred.
Cook an onion-tomato masala until thick and glossy.
Add the grilled paneer and capsicum to the gravy.
Finish with garam masala and serve with naan.

title: Malai Kofta
instructions: Mash paneer and potato, shape into balls and deep fry until golden.
Blend tomato and cashews and cook into a rich gravy with spices.
Stir in cream for a silky finish.
Add the koftas just before serving so they stay soft.

title: Vegetable Korma
instructions: Blend coconut and cashews into a smooth paste.
Saute onion and spices, then add the mixed vegetables.
Add the coconut-cashew paste and simmer until creamy.
Cook until the vegetables are tender and serve with rice or roti.

title: Tawa Pulao
instructions: Saute onion, capsicum and tomato on a hot tawa.
Add peas, pav bhaji masala and salt.
Fold in cooked rice and toss until well coated.
Garnish with coriander and serve with lemon.

title: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Marinate chicken in curd, fried onions and biryani masala for an hour.
Parboil the rice with whole spices and drain.
Layer marinated chicken with rice, mint and saffron milk.
Cover and cook on dum for 30 minutes, then gently fluff and serve.

title: Tandoori Chicken
instructions: Make deep cuts in the chicken and rub with lemon and salt.
Marinate in curd, ginger-garlic paste and spices for several hours.
Grill, bake or air-fry until charred and cooked through.
Baste with butter and serve with onion rings and mint chutney.

title: Kadai Paneer
instructions: Dry roast and crush coriander seeds and red chili for kadai masala.
Saute onion and capsicum chunks until just tender.
Add tomato and the kadai masala and cook into a thick gravy.
Toss in paneer cubes and finish with crushed kasuri methi.

title: Dal Fry
instructions: Pressure cook both dals with turmeric and salt.
Fry onion, garlic and tomato in ghee with spices.
Add the cooked dal and simmer until well blended.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

title: Mixed Vegetable Curry
instructions: Saute onion and tomato into a masala with spices.
Add the chopped mixed vegetables and mix to coat.
Add water, cover and cook until tender.
Finish with garam masala and coriander.

title: Stuffed Capsicum
instructions: Slice the tops off the capsicums and remove the seeds.
Make a spiced filling of mashed potato, paneer and onion.
Stuff the capsicums tightly with the filling.
Cook covered on a tawa, turning gently, until the capsicum softens.

title: Methi Malai Matar
instructions: Blanch the methi to reduce bitterness.
Make a white gravy with onion-cashew paste.
Add peas and methi and cook until tender.
Stir in cream and a pinch of sugar and simmer briefly.

title: Veg Fried Rice
instructions: Use cooked, cooled rice for the best texture.
Stir-fry the chopped vegetables on high heat until crisp-tender.
Add soy sauce, pepper and salt.
Toss in the rice and fry until well combined.

title: Mushroom Masala
instructions: Saute the mushrooms until the water evaporates and set aside.
Cook an onion-tomato-ginger masala with spices.
Return the mushrooms and toss to coat.
Add a splash of water, simmer and finish with garam masala.

title: Aloo Matar
instructions: Temper cumin and saute onion until golden.
Add tomato, turmeric and spices and cook into a masala.
Add potato cubes and peas with water.
Cover and simmer until the potatoes are soft.

title: Prawn Masala
instructions: Clean and devein the prawns and marinate with turmeric and salt.
Make an onion-tomato-ginger-garlic masala with spices.
Add the prawns and cook briefly so they stay tender.
Add a little water, simmer and garnish with coriander.

title: Chicken Tikka
instructions: Cut chicken into cubes and marinate in curd, ginger-garlic and spices.
Rest for at least an hour for the flavours to penetrate.
Thread onto skewers and grill or pan-sear until charred.
Squeeze lemon over the top and serve with mint chutney.

title: Paneer Bhurji
instructions: Saute onion, green chili and capsicum until soft.
Add tomato, turmeric and spices and cook briefly.
Crumble in the paneer and toss to combine.
Cook for a couple of minutes and garnish with coriander.

title: Soya Chunk Curry
instructions: Boil the soya chunks, then squeeze out the water.
Make an onion-tomato-ginger-garlic masala with spices.
Add the soya chunks and toss to coat.
Add water, simmer until thick and finish with garam masala.

title: Lauki Kofta
instructions: Grate and squeeze the lauki, then mix with besan and spices.
Shape into balls and deep fry until golden.
Cook an onion-tomato gravy with spices and cream.
Add the koftas just before serving so they stay soft.

title: Samosa
instructions: Make a stiff dough with flour, oil and water and rest it.
Cook a spiced filling of mashed potato, peas and green chili.
Shape the dough into cones, fill and seal the edges.
Deep fry on low-medium heat until golden and crisp.

title: Onion Pakora
instructions: Slice the onions thin and mix with besan, spices and a little water.
Let the mixture rest so the onions release moisture.
Drop small clusters into hot oil.
Fry until golden and crisp and serve with chutney.

title: Vada Pav
instructions: Make a spiced potato mash tempered with mustard, garlic and chili.
Shape into balls, dip in besan batter and deep fry into vadas.
Slit the pav and spread garlic and green chutney inside.
Place a vada in each pav and serve hot.

title: Pav Bhaji
instructions: Boil and mash potato, cauliflower and peas.
Saute onion, tomato and capsicum with pav bhaji masala in butter.
Add the mashed vegetables and cook until thick, mashing as you go.
Toast the pav in butter and serve with the bhaji and lemon.

title: Dhokla
instructions: Make a smooth besan batter with lemon, salt and a little sugar.
Add fruit salt, mix and pour into a greased tray.
Steam for 15 minutes until spongy, then cut into squares.
Pour over a tempering of mustard seeds, green chili and curry leaves.

title: Aloo Tikki
instructions: Mash the boiled potatoes with peas, green chili and spices.
Shape into round flat patties.
Shallow fry on a tawa until golden and crisp on both sides.
Serve with tamarind and mint chutney.

title: Bhel Puri
instructions: Combine puffed rice with chopped onion, tomato and boiled potato.
Add tamarind and green chutney and toss quickly.
Top with sev and crushed papdi.
Garnish with coriander and serve immediately so it stays crisp.

title: Sev Puri
instructions: Arrange the flat puris on a plate.
Top each with boiled potato and chopped onion.
Drizzle tamarind and green chutney.
Sprinkle generously with sev and coriander and serve at once.

title: Masala Chai
instructions: Boil water with crushed ginger and cardamom.
Add the tea leaves and let it brew.
Pour in the milk and sugar and bring to a rolling boil.
Strain into cups and serve hot.

title: Paneer Tikka
instructions: Whisk curd with spices into a thick marinade.
Coat paneer cubes, capsicum and onion chunks in the marinade.
Thread onto skewers and grill until charred at the edges.
Sprinkle chaat masala and lemon and serve hot.

title: Veg Cutlet
instructions: Boil and mash the mixed vegetables with spices.
Shape into patties and coat in bread crumbs.
Shallow fry until golden and crisp on both sides.
Serve hot with ketchup or green chutney.

title: Bread Pakora
instructions: Make a spiced mashed potato filling.
Sandwich the filling between bread slices and cut into triangles.
Dip in a besan batter seasoned with spices.
Deep fry until golden and serve hot with chutney.

title: Corn Chaat
instructions: Boil or steam the corn until tender.
Toss with butter, chopped onion and tomato.
Add lemon juice, chaat masala and salt.
Mix well and serve warm.

title: Hara Bhara Kabab
instructions: Blanch the spinach and peas and mash with boiled potato.
Mix in green chili, besan and spices to bind.
Shape into patties.
Shallow fry until golden and serve with mint chutney.

title: Chana Chaat
instructions: Use boiled chickpeas as the base.
Add chopped onion, tomato and coriander.
Season with lemon juice, chaat masala and salt.
Toss well and serve fresh.

title: Mathri
instructions: Make a stiff dough with flour, suji, ajwain, pepper and oil.
Roll out and cut into small discs, then prick with a fork.
Deep fry on low heat until crisp and pale golden.
Cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

title: Kachori
instructions: Soak and coarsely grind the moong dal.
Cook the dal with fennel and spices into a dry filling.
Stuff dough balls with the filling and roll out gently.
Deep fry on low heat until puffed, crisp and golden.

title: Veg Frankie
instructions: Make soft roti from the dough and cook on a tawa.
Prepare a spiced potato filling and roll into logs.
Place the filling on the roti with onion and capsicum.
Sprinkle chaat masala, roll up tightly and serve.

title: Chicken 65
instructions: Marinate chicken cubes in curd, rice flour, ginger and spices.
Deep fry until crisp and cooked through.
Temper curry leaves and green chili in a little oil.
Toss the fried chicken in the tempering and serve hot.

title: Dahi Vada
instructions: Soak and grind urad dal into a fluffy batter, then deep fry into vadas.
Soak the fried vadas in water, then gently squeeze.
Arrange on a plate and cover with whisked sweetened curd.
Drizzle tamarind chutney and sprinkle cumin and chili powder.

title: Akki Roti
instructions: Mix rice flour with chopped onion, grated carrot, green chili and coriander.
Add warm water and salt and knead into a soft dough.
Pat the dough directly onto a hot tawa into a thin round.
Drizzle oil, cover and cook both sides until golden, then serve with chutney.

title: Veg Mayo Sandwich
instructions: Whisk the mayonnaise with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Thinly slice the tomato, capsicum, onion and cucumber.
Spread mayo on the bread and layer the veggies.
Close, grill or toast lightly, slice diagonally and serve.

title: Cheese Corn Sandwich
instructions: Boil the sweet corn until tender and drain.
Mix corn with grated cheese, chopped capsicum, mayo, salt and pepper.
Spread the filling between bread slices.
Grill until golden and the cheese melts; serve hot.

title: Paneer Sandwich
instructions: Crumble or grate the paneer and mix with chopped onion, capsicum, tomato and coriander.
Season with salt, pepper and a little red chili powder.
Stuff the filling between bread slices.
Grill with a little butter until crisp and golden.

title: Grilled Vegetable Sandwich
instructions: Boil and slice the potato; thinly slice tomato, capsicum and onion.
Butter the bread and sprinkle a little chaat masala.
Layer the veggies and cheese between slices.
Grill in a sandwich press until crisp and golden, then serve with chutney.

title: Open Veg Toast
instructions: Finely chop the tomato, capsicum and onion.
Top each bread slice with the veggies and grated cheese.
Sprinkle salt, pepper and a pinch of oregano or chili.
Toast in an oven or air-fryer until the cheese bubbles.

title: Cheese Garlic Toast
instructions: Mash the garlic into softened butter with chopped coriander.
Spread generously over the bread.
Top with grated cheese.
Toast or bake until golden and the cheese melts.

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix minced garlic and chopped coriander into softened butter.
Slit a baguette or thick bread without cutting all the way through.
Spread the garlic butter into the slits and on top.
Bake at 180°C for 8–10 minutes until crisp and golden.

title: Chilli Cheese Toast
instructions: Mix grated cheese with finely chopped green chili and capsicum.
Butter the bread and spread the cheese mixture on top.
Toast or grill until the cheese melts and bubbles.
Slice and serve hot.

title: Paneer Wrap
instructions: Knead atta into a soft dough and roll into thin rotis; cook on a tawa.
Marinate paneer strips in curd and spices, then sauté with onion and capsicum.
Spread mayo on the roti and add the paneer filling.
Roll up tightly, wrap in foil and serve.

title: Veg Wrap
instructions: Make thin rotis from the atta dough.
Shred the cabbage, carrot, capsicum and onion into a slaw.
Toss the slaw with mayo, salt and pepper.
Fill the roti, roll up and serve fresh.

title: Pasta Arrabbiata
instructions: Boil the pasta until al dente, reserving a little water.
Sauté garlic and onion in oil, then add pureed tomatoes and chili flakes.
Simmer into a spicy red sauce and season with salt.
Toss the pasta through the sauce and serve hot.

title: White Sauce Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta until al dente.
Make a roux with butter and flour, then whisk in milk to a smooth sauce.
Stir in cheese, salt, pepper and sautéed capsicum.
Fold in the pasta and serve creamy and hot.

title: Masala Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta and drain.
Sauté onion, capsicum and tomato with Indian spices.
Add the garam masala and a splash of water to form a masala.
Toss the pasta through and garnish with coriander.

title: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Use cooked, cooled rice for the best texture.
Scramble the eggs in hot oil and set aside.
Stir-fry chopped carrot, capsicum and spring onion on high heat.
Add rice, egg, soy sauce, salt and pepper; toss and serve.

title: Veg Noodles
instructions: Boil the noodles, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the shredded vegetables on high heat until crisp-tender.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Toss in the noodles and serve hot.

title: Schezwan Noodles
instructions: Boil and drain the noodles.
Sauté garlic, then stir-fry the shredded vegetables on high heat.
Add schezwan sauce, a splash of soy sauce and salt.
Toss in the noodles until coated and serve hot.

title: Veg Manchurian
instructions: Grate cabbage and carrot, mix with besan and a little flour, shape into balls and deep fry.
Sauté garlic and spring onion in oil.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, a little cornflour slurry and water for the gravy.
Toss in the fried balls just before serving so they stay crisp.

title: Chilli Paneer
instructions: Toss paneer cubes in cornflour and pan-fry until golden.
Sauté garlic, onion and capsicum chunks on high heat.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, salt and a little water.
Toss in the paneer and spring onion; serve hot.

title: Schezwan Fried Rice
instructions: Use cooked, cooled rice.
Stir-fry the chopped vegetables on high heat.
Add schezwan sauce, salt and pepper.
Toss in the rice until well coated and serve hot.

title: Masala Maggi
instructions: Sauté chopped onion, tomato, capsicum and peas in a little oil.
Add water and the noodles with the masala sachet.
Cook until the water is absorbed and the noodles are soft.
Garnish with coriander and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Masala Oats
instructions: Temper cumin and sauté onion, tomato, carrot and peas.
Add turmeric, salt and a little water.
Stir in the oats and cook 3–4 minutes until soft.
Finish with coriander and lemon.

title: Curd Rice
instructions: Mash soft-cooked rice and let it cool.
Mix in the curd, salt and a little milk for creaminess.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger and green chili.
Stir the tempering through and serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Sprouts Salad
instructions: Lightly steam the moong sprouts if you prefer them soft.
Chop the onion, tomato, cucumber and coriander.
Toss everything with lemon juice, salt and chaat masala.
Serve fresh and crunchy.

title: Cheese Omelette
instructions: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Sauté chopped onion and capsicum, then pour in the eggs.
Sprinkle grated cheese over one half.
Fold over once set and serve hot.

title: Bread Omelette
instructions: Beat the eggs with chopped onion, capsicum, green chili, salt and pepper.
Pour into a hot oiled pan.
Place the bread slices on top and press gently.
Flip to coat both sides in egg and cook until golden; serve hot.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Simmer tomato, onion and garlic with water until very soft.
Blend smooth and strain back into the pan.
Season with salt, pepper and a little sugar; warm through with butter.
Swirl in cream and serve hot with croutons.
